name: Sacrifice Life
description: When the creature's controlling nihileth takes damage while within 30 feet of the creature, the creature can send its life force to the nihileth. The creature's hp is reduced by up to the amount of damage the nihileth took, preventing that amount of damage to the nihileth. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hp, it is immediately destroyed. A nihileth can benefit from only one zombie's Sacrifice Life for each source of damage it takes.
